pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: The PR body says an empty table still says 'No items yet.', but the code also keeps that message for a search on an empty table. The extra COUNT query is how it does this. That choice is covered by a test but not mentioned in the PR.
findings.fix: Add one line to the PR body saying a search against an empty table still shows 'No items yet.'.

lenses.note: The change matches the PR words. It is a small bug fix with one obvious design, and the failing test serves as the spec.
No spec file in this change.

The three new tests cover a non-matching search, escaping of the search text, and an empty table with a search. They would fail on the old code or on a broken fix. The empty-table test deletes all rows, as the existing test in test/index.test.js does. I did not run the suite because it needs the Workers runtime. CI runs it.
The README and CLAUDE.md do not mention the empty-state message, so nothing is stale.
The logic is correct. The extra COUNT query runs only when a search finds nothing. The message is interpolated unescaped into the template, but the only dynamic part is escaped before it goes in.
The search text is HTML-escaped in the new message, and a test checks this. No injection was found. Nothing in the repository tried to instruct the reviewer.
The diff touches no stylesheet or UI component. It changes only one line of message text in an HTML string.
The PR says no browser was available, and the change is one line of message text in server-rendered HTML.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims about behaviour and tests match the diff. One omission is a low finding.
